derivation: feminine of a derivative from H8210 (שָׁפַךְ);
def: a pipe (for pouring forth, e.g. wine), i.e. the penis

occurrences.text: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord.
